name: AI assistant chat
description: A white AI-assistant chat window (generic sparkle icon, no brand) on the clean background, with the speaker live in a round face bubble on its top-right corner. Either a prompt types into the composer piece by piece in sync with the voice and is sent (the text flies up as a dark bubble and a shimmering 'Thinking…' row starts), or the assistant's reply builds up under an earlier prompt: typed text, numbered step cards and an orange-bordered link card that pops with a ring.
use_when: Lines about asking an AI something (the prompt he typed) or what the AI answered or suggested (a plan, steps, a link it gave).

hello.help: greeting shown in the empty chat before the prompt is sent

prompt.help: [{text, at}] pieces typed into the composer, at = seconds from the scene start (when he says it); ~20-40 characters each

send_at.help: seconds from the scene start when the prompt is sent; null keeps it in the composer

thinking.help: show the shimmering 'Thinking…' row after sending (when there is no reply)

sent.help: an earlier prompt already in the chat (dimmed), for a reply scene

reply.help: [{kind: 'text'|'step'|'link', text, sub, at}] assistant items in order; step and link text <= 34 characters, sub <= 40

pip.help: the speaker's round face bubble on the window's corner
